fields.title: Clinical Trial Design & Protocol Development
fields.description: Learn how to frame a clinical research question, select an appropriate study design, develop a defensible protocol, and plan outcomes that can produce reliable evidence. Covers trial phases, randomization, blinding, sample size, and ethical review readiness.
fields.short_description: Design clear, ethical, and analysis-ready clinical trials

fields.title: Biostatistics for Clinical Research
fields.description: Build practical statistical reasoning for clinical studies, from descriptive summaries and uncertainty to regression, power, and transparent interpretation of results. Covers t-tests, ANOVA, chi-square, linear and logistic regression, Kaplan-Meier survival analysis, and sample-size calculation using clinical examples.
fields.short_description: Use statistics confidently to interpret clinical evidence

fields.title: Systematic Reviews & Evidence Synthesis
fields.description: Move from a focused research question to a reproducible search, critical appraisal, evidence table, and clear synthesis suitable for clinical decision-making. Covers PRISMA standards, risk-of-bias tools, GRADE methodology, and meta-analysis interpretation.
fields.short_description: Plan reproducible reviews that turn literature into evidence

fields.title: Real-World Evidence & Observational Research
fields.description: Explore methods for real-world evidence and observational research, including data quality, clinical context, confounding control, and transparent communication of findings. Covers cohort and case-control designs, propensity score methods, and sensitivity analysis.
fields.short_description: Apply rigorous methods to real-world clinical data questions

fields.title: Scientific & Medical Manuscript Writing
fields.description: Develop a publishable scientific manuscript from research question to discussion, using clear structure, evidence-aware language, effective tables and figures, and transparent reporting practices. Covers IMRaD structure, abstract writing, results reporting, and journal selection strategies.
fields.short_description: Turn rigorous research into a clear, publishable manuscript

fields.title: Research Ethics, GCP & Publication Integrity
fields.description: Strengthen the trustworthiness of health research through informed consent, governance, Good Clinical Practice, data stewardship, authorship, peer review, and publication integrity. Covers IRB processes, informed consent design, data privacy regulations, and responsible authorship guidelines.
fields.short_description: Build trustworthy research from protocol to publication

fields.title: Epidemiology & Clinical Research Methods
fields.description: Master study designs that establish causality and quantify risk in clinical populations. Covers cohort studies, case-control designs, cross-sectional surveys, measures of association, confounding, bias, and causal inference frameworks for health research.
fields.short_description: Study designs that reveal causes and risks in health

fields.title: Clinical Data Management & Research Informatics
fields.description: Build robust data pipelines for clinical research — from case report form design and database architecture to quality control, data cleaning, and regulatory submissions. Covers REDCap, CDISC standards, and reproducible data workflows for multi-site studies.
fields.short_description: Manage clinical data with structure, quality, and reproducibility
